links.comparator_used: Standard first-in-first-out (FIFO) histopathology workflow in a discrete-event simulation
links.outcome: Average diagnostic turnaround time for suspicious cases (simulated one-year period)
links.effect: Reduced average TAT for suspicious cases by 38.2% (from 7.2 to 4.5 days)
links.tradeoff: Slightly increased TAT for benign cases; results come from a simulation using synthetic data, not real clinical deployment
links.quote: The simulation demonstrated that the triage system reduced the average TAT for suspicious cases by 38.2% (from 7.2 to 4.5 days) while slightly increasing the TAT for benign cases.

design_hint: AI-based triage prioritization of biopsy cases versus FIFO workflow
